title: Special Permutations (Bitmask Hamiltonian DP)

monster.name: Divisibility Lich
monster.title: Weaver of Permutational Divisibility
monster.defeatQuote: Count of special permutations where every adjacent pair divides modulo 10^9+7!

description: Given an array `nums` of `n` distinct positive integers. A permutation is special if for all adjacent indices `i`: `nums[i] % nums[i+1] == 0` or `nums[i+1] % nums[i] == 0`. Return the total number of special permutations modulo `10^9 + 7`.
